steps.message: What is on my schedule for October 27 2023 at 10:30am in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date; ls /data/data | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar|fossify'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "start=$(date -d '2023-10-27 10:30:00 UTC' +%s000); end=$(date -d '2023-10-27 10:31:00 UTC' +%s000); echo $start $end; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$start/$end --projection title:begin:end:event_id"
